scopes.layout: planned monorepo — apps/api (FastAPI), apps/web (React; /admin/ lives here), apps/game-unity (Unity 6.3 LTS / C#), packages/, tools/, infrastructure/ (compose, nginx, web-image, keycloak, scripts, backup). Trees may not exist yet. See game-platform-base-plan_v2.1.md § Repository Layout.
scopes.note: No application lockfiles yet. test_commands stay empty until each app documents a real runner. Do not invent pipenv/ruff or Unity batch commands. Unity is a first-class scope; pack ADAPT has no C# recipe. When apps exist, re-run bootstrap-workflow to fill test_commands and switch default_scope to one primary app glob.

hosting.note: Private GitHub raimondskrauklis/rocky-observatory. Production Revy (revy.createit.digital) reviews PRs — same GitHub App as raimondskrauklis/revy (dogfood). Push when the user asks; do not open PRs unless asked. Never push while Revy is pending.

review_context.sync_rule: On program switch: edit .revy first, then copy to .agent/review-context.json

revy-babysit.note: Poll/fix when the user asks. Never auto-start as a substitute for local Bugbot.
